issuer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
edition: Visa Application Form to Enter Japan, English PDF of March 2023 (2 pages, with “Certificate of Eligibility No.”)
summary: The Visa Application Form to Enter Japan (査証申請書) is the 2-page form of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan that you complete to apply for a Japanese visa, for a short stay or, with a Certificate of Eligibility, for work, study or a long stay. Every applicant who needs a visa fills in and signs their own form and hands it in with a photo, a passport and supporting documents to the Japanese embassy or consulate for their place of residence, or to the agency it designates.
